hero.title: Find the WiFi, mobile, and streaming that fits your life
hero.subtitle: Take a look around. Every plan comes with a 5-year price guarantee and no annual contract, so there is no pressure to decide today.
grid.title: Browse plans and services
grid.subtitle: Tap any card to learn more. No commitment, just a closer look.
item-1.title: Xfinity Gig Internet
item-1.body: Fiber-powered Gig WiFi for busy, always-online homes, with unlimited data and the xFi Gateway included.
item-2.title: Xfinity Internet 500 Mbps
item-2.body: Fast, reliable WiFi that keeps up with every device at once, plus a free Xfinity Mobile line for a year.
item-3.title: Xfinity Internet 300 Mbps
item-3.body: Simple, seamless WiFi with 99.9% reliability and same-day self-install. A great value starter plan.
item-4.title: Xfinity Mobile - Mobile Select
item-4.body: Unlimited talk, text, and data on the most reliable 5G network. Try a line free for a year with Internet.
item-5.title: Xfinity Mobile - Mobile Plus
item-5.body: Everything in Mobile Select plus the best phone deals and device protection for life.
item-6.title: StreamSaver and Streaming Apps
item-6.body: Peacock, Netflix, and Apple TV+ together on one simple bill, managed right in the Xfinity app.
perks.title: Good to know as you browse
perks.list: xFi Gateway included on select plans
spotlight.title: Complete your setup
spotlight.subtitle: Equipment and add-ons that round out your home network.
item-7.title: xFi Gateway
item-7.body: The all-in-one modem and router that delivers powerful whole-home WiFi and Advanced Security. Included with your plan.
item-8.title: Xfinity Pro
item-8.body: Professional-grade WiFi that reaches every room, with 4G LTE backup so you stay connected during outages.
closing.title: Take your time and explore
closing.subtitle: Check availability at your address to see the plans and prices near you.
